description: Convert between South Korean jeonse deposit and monthly rent (wolse) at a conversion rate, with the statutory 4.5% cap check on a landlord's asked rent.

askedMonthlyRent.description: Rent the landlord asks, to compare with the legal cap (KRW)

ratePct.description: Annual conversion rate in percent; default 4.5 (statutory cap)
